title: JSON_GET_FIELD_VALUES
description: Returns a list containing the value of the specified field from each map in the provided list. Optionally excludes null values from the result.

parameters.name: json_array
parameters.description: The list of maps to extract values from.

parameters.name: field_name
parameters.description: The name of the field whose value is extracted from each map.

parameters.name: exclude_nulls
parameters.description: If TRUE, maps whose field value is null or missing are omitted from the result. If FALSE, their values are included as null.

examples:
JSON_GET_FIELD_VALUES(VLOOKUP_ALL("Account", "Name", "OwnerId", OwnerId), "Name", true)
-- Returns the Name from every matching Account, e.g. (Acme, Global).

JSON_GET_FIELD_VALUES(VLOOKUP_ALL("Contact", "Phone", "AccountId", Id), "Phone", false)
-- Returns the Phone value from every matching Contact, e.g. (null, (123)456-7890).
